notes: Two separate circuits (sender and receiver) are combined in one graph; the boards communicate over LoRa radio, which is not a physical edge.
The MKR WAN 1310 is not in the catalogue, so a new type was created from the pin labels in the diagrams; the antenna is a new type attached to the board's u.FL connector.
Breadboard naming follows the catalogue (bank 'b' = rows f-j). In the images, rows f-j are drawn on the upper half, so the upper half is named bank 'b'.

Pushbutton: the two visible legs are treated as 1.l and 2.l, because the sketch uses INPUT_PULLUP and pressing must connect GND to pin 2. Legs are in columns 5 and 7, row g. Wires end in row f of the same column strips.

LED: the bent (longer) leg is the anode in column 8, and the straight leg is the cathode in column 6, both in row h. The resistor spans columns 8 to 11 in row g. The resistor value is not stated in the manual, so 220 ohm is assumed.
The 2x micro USB cables and the computers are listed but not drawn in the circuit images, so they are omitted from the graph.
